provenance: Computed after a no-context audit agent (2026-08-05) flagged that the corrected precision no longer charges for verbosity. Its two alternative views were independently reproduced from data/ before recording here. Convention matches summary.json: precision = TP/(TP+FP); duplicate hits on an already-matched golden count as neither.
candidate_counts_note: Real candidate counts per tool: nathan-code-review 775, coderabbit 318, augment 178, cubic-v2 175, claude-code 173, greptile-v4-1 168. TP+FP differs (771/297/171/162/164/165) because candidates that duplicate an already-matched golden are excluded from both.

validated_golden_only.target: the 114 golden comments that survived blind verification; no discovery credit on either side

consensus_exam.target: 114 validated golden + 193 clusters raised by at least two tools = 307 items; no single tool defines the exam

verbosity_curve.note: our candidates truncated per-PR by severity (Critical > Suggestion > Nit, report order within a tier), recall against the 114 validated golden; post-hoc truncation, so a lower bound

loo_asymmetry.note: loo_ground_truth summed per tool; each tool's LOO exam drops only its own solo finds, so the exams differ in size and the comparison is not symmetric
